text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hello. I'm currently giving a rundown of the Unity Cup to those who want to learn about it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Do you want to hear an explanation too, <username>?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What would you like me to explain?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What should I ask about?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The Unity Cup is a team-based competition held by Tracen Academy that runs concurrently with the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Whereas the Twinkle Series tests individual performance, the Unity Cup puts emphasis on teamwork.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The Unity Cup consists of a series of preseason rounds followed by the finals.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The four rounds of preseason races are held to decide your team's ranking.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If you'd like to learn more about Team Ranking, please ask me about team stats! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: There will be plenty of downtime between preseason matches, so use it to train up your team members!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: By the way, I recommend raising your team's strength through Unity Training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If you'd like to learn more about Unity Training, please ask me about team members and Unity Training! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Once the preseason's over, the finals will begin! This final round of races determines the victors of the Unity Cup!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Even if you don't do as well as you wanted in the preseason, if you win the finals, then you win the whole tournament!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Make sure not to lose hope and keep aiming for victory right until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That's everything about the Unity Cup. Is there anything else you'd like to know about?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The Unity Cup is held after the late June and late December turns end.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Teams will compete in five categories—sprint, mile, medium, long, and dirt.
color_text_info_list: sprint, mile, medium, long, and dirt

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You must enter at least one runner in each race, and up to three can be assigned to each category.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: At the beginning of each Unity Cup match, a team will be formed automatically from the members you have recruited.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: But don't worry, you can edit your team manually, too! Feel free to arrange your racers as best you see fit!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Once you've finalized your team, you can select an opponent to face.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If you defeat the opposing team, it will help your trainee grow stronger…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: And the higher your opponent's Team Ranking, the more growth you can expect.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Defeating high-ranking opponents will also grant a larger increase to your own Team Ranking!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: However, your ranking won't go up if you lose, so aim for victory!
color_text_info_list: your ranking won't go up if you lose

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You can use the pre-race predictions to help you decide who to take on.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Once you've chosen an opponent, it's time for the races. Whichever team places first in the majority of the five races is deemed the victor!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That's not all! If you clear the following three conditions during the preseason, you'll be able to challenge an elite team!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: First, raise your team ranking to a certain level. Second, raise your team power to a certain level.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Third, have team members who have triggered an Extreme Spirit Burst.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You'll get a great reward if you beat this elite team… and something special might happen in the finals!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Strive for victory and create the best team out there!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Once the preseason is over, the finals await you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The team that wins the finals is crowned the champion of the Unity Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That's everything about the Unity Cup races. Is there anything else you'd like to know about?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume in your team are, naturally, your team members.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: At the moment, your team members consist only of your Trainee Umamusume, <chrname>, and the Umamusume featured in your Support Cards.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: But fret not.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'm certain that if you do well during the preseason, more Umamusume will hear about your team and want to join you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume who join your team will be able to participate in the Unity Cup races as well as training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: There's one thing you need to keep in mind about Umamusume in your team who are not featured in Support Cards, though.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: They cannot trigger Friendship Training and won't have hint events.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Next, let me explain Unity Training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If you train in the same location as your team members, you can activate Unity Training, a form of training where members mutually support each other.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Whether or not a team member will trigger Unity Training is randomly decided each time they are assigned to a training type.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: A special icon will appear when Unity Training is available, so keep your eyes peeled.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: During Unity Training, the attributes of the participating team members will increase.
color_text_info_list: attributes of the participating team members will increase

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What's more, if you perform Unity Training with two or more team members at once, the effects of that training on your trainee will increase as well.
color_text_info_list: two or more team members at once
effects of that training on your trainee will increase

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The more members in a Unity Training session, the more effective the training, so have fun training with your team!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's one more thing I should tell you about the frequency of Unity Training getting triggered.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The chances of it getting activated can be boosted by Hint Frequency and the number of members training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Keep this in mind as you train your team!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Also, you have a chance of earning skill hints after each Unity Training session!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: And if you perform Unity Training enough times, something special might happen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: As team members perform Unity Training, their dedication to the team will grow, which can lead to a phenomenon known as a Spirit Burst!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Spirit Bursts help power up your team members and may also grant your trainee skill hints.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Try to trigger Spirit Bursts for as many members as you can to help your whole team grow stronger!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That's not all!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Team members who have triggered a Spirit Burst can also trigger an Extreme Spirit Burst during Unity Training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Extreme Spirit Bursts are easier to trigger if the team member in question participates in Friendship Training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Training is guaranteed to succeed if an Extreme Spirit Burst occurs. That's the power of a team for you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Triggering Extreme Spirit Burst can earn you special skill hints, so don't let the chance slip you by! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That's everything about team members and Unity Training. Is there anything else you'd like to know about?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Sure. I'd be happy to explain Team Ranking, Team Power, and Team Titles.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You can check your team's stats from the screen where you select which activity to perform each turn.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Your Team Ranking represents the position of your team during the preseason.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You can increase your ranking by winning races in the Unity Cup. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The higher your Team Ranking, the more motivated your team will be, and the better they'll perform in the Unity Cup.
color_text_info_list: the better they'll perform in the Unity Cup

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Do your best to get it as high as possible!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Team Power, as its name suggests, is your team's overall power.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: This will go up as you train your team members through Unity Training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: When your team's attributes reach certain thresholds, it will also cause your training levels to increase, so focus on making your team ever stronger!
color_text_info_list: your team's attributes reach certain thresholds

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: As you increase your Team Power by building your team members' attributes, you'll earn upgrades to your clubroom when it reaches certain levels.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Clubroom upgrades make it easier to recruit talented members after each Unity Cup match.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Finally, there's your Team Title. This is a measure of your overall performance during the preseason, and is based on both your Team Ranking and Team Power.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The better the Team Title you earn, the better rewards you'll receive at the very end of your playthrough.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I hope you give your all during the Unity Cup and train to get the best title you can. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That's everything about team stats. Is there anything else you'd like to know about?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Very well! ♪ Just in case, I've prepared a summary of everything you'll need to know.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Simply tap the "i" button in the top left of the screen if you ever need a refresher.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I wish you the best of luck. I'll be cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Okay. I wish you the best of luck. I'll be cheering you on!
